**CEDAR CREEK SCHOOL DISTRICT**
**MAINTENANCE LOG — ACCESSIBLE EQUIPMENT & FACILITIES**
Family: S03 / Cedar Creek Maintenance Team

---

**Log Conventions:**
- Status codes: IN SERVICE / OOS (out of service) / PENDING PART / AWAITING INSP
- Parts used are listed with part number where available.
- Entries with a red margin mark (R) indicate urgent follow-up needed.
- Older entries are handwritten; newer entries are typed. Handwriting may be difficult to read in places.

---

**08/05/2025 — 08:15 AM — Routine check, Front Entrance Power Door (Bldg A)**
Checked actuator arm, sensor beam, and safety reverse. All functions normal. Lubricated hinge track. Status: IN SERVICE. No parts used.

**08/12/2025 — 10:45 AM — Classroom 112 Hoyer Lift (Ceiling Track)**
Reported by aide: lift motor making grinding noise when moving along track. Removed cover, found worn gear in drive assembly. Ordered replacement gear (P/N HL-1142). Unit placed OOS pending part. Notified SPED office.

**08/18/2025 — 01:20 PM — Accessible Van 1 — Monthly Inspection**
Performed monthly inspection per district schedule. Checked lift operation, tie-downs, intercom, and emergency exit. All systems functional. Oil level good, tires at 55 psi. Accessible Van 1 has_repair_status in_service per maintenance log. Record status: current. Status: IN SERVICE. Next inspection due 09/15/2025.

**08/26/2025 — 09:05 AM — Library Accessible Workstation**
Replaced adjustable-height desk actuator (P/N AD-2200). Desk now raises/lowers smoothly. Status: IN SERVICE.

**09/03/2025 — 02:00 PM — Cafeteria Ramp Threshold Plate**
Plate at south exit loose, trip hazard. Replaced mounting screws, added second anchor point. Status: IN SERVICE.

**09/09/2025 — 11:30 AM — Classroom 112 Hoyer Lift — Part Arrived**
Replaced drive gear (P/N HL-1142). Tested with 100-lb load. Operation quiet and smooth. Status: IN SERVICE. Returned lift to service.

**09/15/2025 — 07:50 AM — Accessible Van 1 — Monthly Inspection**
Checked lift, tie-downs, fire extinguisher, first aid kit. All good. Coolant level topped off. Status: IN SERVICE.

**09/22/2025 — 03:40 PM — Auditorium Wheelchair Platform Lift**
Intermittent operation reported. Found loose wiring connection at control panel. Reconnected and secured. Tested multiple cycles. Status: IN SERVICE.

**10/02/2025 — 08:30 AM — Restroom 114 (Accessible Stall)**
Grab bar on left wall loose. Removed, re-anchored to stud with new bolts (P/N GB-409). Status: IN SERVICE.

**10/14/2025 — 12:15 PM — Accessible Van 1 — Brake Light Issue**
Driver reported brake lights not working. Replaced both bulbs, checked wiring harness. Tested. Status: IN SERVICE.

**10/21/2025 — 09:45 AM — Front Entrance Power Door — Sensor Drift**
Door occasionally failed to open. Recalibrated motion sensor per manufacturer specs. Status: IN SERVICE.

**11/04/2025 — 01:00 PM — Classroom 112 Hoyer Lift — Annual Inspection**
Annual inspection performed. Track, motor, and straps all in good condition. No parts needed. Status: IN SERVICE.

**11/12/2025 — 10:10 AM — Accessible Van 1 — Monthly Inspection**
Lift operation good. Checked battery and electrical system. Battery 12.4V, acceptable. Status: IN SERVICE.

**11/20/2025 — 02:30 PM — Gymnasium Accessible Door (North)**
Door closer too slow, door not staying open. Replaced closer unit (P/N DC-771). Status: IN SERVICE.

**12/01/2025 — 08:00 AM — Cafeteria Ramp — Ice Damage Check**
Crack found in surface near expansion joint. Sealed with concrete patch. Monitor for further cracking. Status: IN SERVICE. (R note: re-check after thaw)

**12/09/2025 — 11:15 AM — Accessible Van 1 — Heating System**
Heater blowing cold air. Replaced thermostat (P/N HT-103). Heat working. Status: IN SERVICE.

**12/16/2025 — 03:00 PM — Auditorium Platform Lift — Safety Edge**
Safety edge strip worn, not triggering reverse. Replaced strip (P/N SE-554). Tested with obstruction. Status: IN SERVICE.

**01/06/2026 — 09:30 AM — Front Entrance Power Door — Winter Adjustment**
Adjusted closing speed for cold weather. Checked sensor range. Status: IN SERVICE.

**04/15/2026 — 02:20 PM — Accessible Van 2 — Brake Issue**
Driver reported brake pedal felt spongy. Inspected brake lines and master cylinder. Found small leak at rear brake line. Replaced line section (P/N BL-182), bled brakes. Pedal firm. Test drove. Status: IN SERVICE.

**04/22/2026 — 09:30 AM — Cafeteria Ramp — Surface Check**

Adjusted closing speed back to standard for warmer weather. Checked sensor range. Status: IN SERVICE.

**05/13/2026 — 03:00 PM — Accessible Van 2 — Electrical Issue**
Van died while idling. Would not restart. Checked battery connections — found corrosion on positive terminal. Cleaned terminals, applied protectant (P/N CT-040). Restarted fine, ran for 20 minutes. Status: IN SERVICE. (R note: keep an eye on this van — electrical gremlins seem to come and go.)

**05/20/2026 — 08:45 AM — Auditorium Platform Lift — Track Inspection**
